caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth in a blue-patterned bowl. Topped with chashu pork, a halved egg, and fresh greens, it sits under warm, natural light against a wooden background.

segments_info.text: Dark brown wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture beneath the bowl.
Chashu pork slice shows browned, tender texture with visible fat marbling and slight char, resting atop translucent onion.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is rich, amber-brown, glossy, and thick, swirling around noodles and toppings.
A halved boiled egg shows a runny, amber yolk nestled in pale, smooth white, with a slightly glossy surface.
White ceramic bowl with blue swirling pattern, smooth glossy surface, and slightly raised rim.
